checkpoint_finding.declared_corpus: 78 image-based spatial samples, 28,909,516 cells, 18 tissues, including 6 human normal or cancer liver samples with 2,373,073 cells
checkpoint_finding.reason: The publication declares liver pretraining context but the exact checkpoint bytes are not bound to a complete accession, donor-alias, and source-version manifest. Later target chronology alone cannot resolve older sources or aliases.

project_source_findings.gse192741: Unknown checkpoint exposure because the public source predates the 2024 blobs and no exact alias crosswalk to the 78 samples is frozen. It is project-exposed downstream and cannot be a seal regardless.
project_source_findings.gse292268: Target labels are temporally unexposed to the 2024 weight blobs, but exact donor and source aliases remain unaudited. The source is blocked and too small.
project_source_findings.hra007511: Unknown until source aliases and checkpoint corpus membership are resolved. Controlled access and project exposure independently prevent a pristine claim.
project_source_findings.vu2025: Target labels are temporally unexposed to the 2024 weight blobs, but exact aliases remain unaudited. The source is DSA- and join-blocked.
project_source_findings.generic_liver: The encoder has definite normal and cancer liver context exposure. This is representation exposure, not MASLD endpoint supervision.

held_donor_finding.frozen_encoder: Potentially inductive only with a development-frozen gene policy, graph recipe, task head or prototypes, domain mapping, and no access to other held donors' features.
held_donor_finding.native_zero_shot: Transductive. zero_shot=True refits K-means prototypes on selected target or reference latent representations and overwrites the checkpoint's prototype behavior.
held_donor_finding.reference_all: Cross-donor transductive because it pools evaluation-cohort features.
held_donor_finding.target_preprocessing: Automatic HVG fitting and slide-level gene mean and standard-deviation estimation use held features. Disable or disclose them; they are not strict frozen preprocessing.
held_donor_finding.fine_tuning: Query-adaptive and a new artifact identity, never synonymous with zero-shot.

spatial_leakage_finding.graph: Generic Delaunay construction without a locked radius can bridge tissue islands. Graph each authoritative participant, core, and section independently and hash the adjacency and distance matrices.
spatial_leakage_finding.vu2025: A capture array mixes four to five participants. No graph is allowed until barcode and tissue-island participant boundaries are frozen.
spatial_leakage_finding.slide_ids: The native default can use process-local Python object IDs. Supply globally unique immutable section IDs to make graphs, batching, queues, and receipts reproducible.
spatial_leakage_finding.domain_selection: Hierarchy level, number of domains, Leiden resolution, leaf mapping, and calibration are development-only choices.
spatial_leakage_finding.replication: Nodes, spots, cells, edges, prototypes, leaves, sections, and arrays are not biological replicates.

known_incidents_and_biases: The Hugging Face checkpoint repository declares neither a license field nor a license file; BSD source-code terms do not grant weight use, adaptation, or redistribution rights.
The current source tag postdates the 2024 weight blobs and has no checkpoint-producing environment or fixed-fixture numeric parity receipt.
The published corpus has definite normal and cancer liver exposure, while checkpoint-specific accession and donor aliases are not bound to the weights.
The official zero-shot API name obscures target K-means refitting and can create cross-donor transduction with reference='all'.
Automatic HVGs and slide statistics can be estimated on target features before evaluation.
The model was pretrained on image-based single-cell assays; Visium evaluation is cross-resolution and can fail for reasons hidden by domain-level metrics.
The optional H&E code path and gated CONCH weights are a separate composite with separate terms; the canonical checkpoint is transcriptomic.
Default Delaunay graphs can join disconnected tissue islands, and default slide IDs can depend on process memory identity.
The newer Novae-scConcept checkpoint is a separate non-admitted composite with 2025/2026 corpus exposure and a 6.7-GB Lightning parent checkpoint; it cannot inherit this audit.
remaining_blockers: Obtain written terms for use, adaptation, and derivative-weight redistribution of the exact canonical checkpoint. Audit underlying training-source rights rather than relying on the aggregate dataset-card tag.

Obtain or reconstruct a checkpoint-bound training manifest with accessions, donor aliases, source versions, platform, tissue, release date, and inclusion receipt; resolve every candidate MASLD cohort alias before assigning an eligible exposure state.

Activate a rights-cleared, adequately powered donor-level spatial RNA source and register a spatial TaskSpec with native baselines, external source, power, uncertainty, multiplicity, and champion gate.

Freeze a strict held-donor adapter that disables target-fit HVGs, defines any transferable expression scaling, uses a section-local outcome-blind graph, and fits heads, prototypes, hierarchy, domains, and calibration on development donors only.
Register the native zero-shot path separately as transductive, prohibit reference='all' in strict held-donor evaluation, and assign new identities to all query-fine-tuned states.
Freeze globally unique section IDs, coordinate units, scale-to-microns, participant and core boundaries, graph implementation and hyperparameters, and adjacency and distance hashes.

After rights and campaign approval, acquire only immutable checkpoint and config blobs, verify SHA-256 and size, enforce safetensors and schema-validated JSON loading offline, and prove exact vocabulary and tensor restoration.

Create an exact runtime lock and pass L40S load, preprocessing, graph boundary, frozen inference, native transductive inference, forward, backward, resume, deterministic-seed, node- and section-order invariance, no-network, and cross-device tolerance probes through SLURM.
interpretation: Novae's public checkpoint is technically addressable and its code is BSD-licensed, but the model itself is not campaign-ready. Weight terms are absent, the corpus has known liver encoder exposure without a checkpoint-bound alias receipt, and its native zero-shot path refits query prototypes. No current MASLD spatial source supplies a rights-cleared, adequately powered, project-reserved donor endpoint. Novae therefore remains deferred and cannot enter v1 or earn a best-model claim.
